note: Synthetic labelled emails for the Jev email lane. Every case is invented; none is real correspondence, so this file is safe to commit and to send to a third party. Labels are the intended answer, frozen before any evaluation run. The split field keeps a held-out half that must not be used for tuning wording or thresholds.
